quotes.text: Yet the biting winds whispered hesitation, tempting the keeper of the flame to hoard the warmth against the coming frost.
Had Kael hoarded his seed out of fear, both would have remained poor.
the keeper must honor that sacred leap by dividing the fifteen glowing sheaves equally, sending half back across the divide
Through the sacred rhythm of entrusting five and returning the fair half
Through the sacred rhythm of sowing five and returning the fair half

note: Kael/Veda; one withholding chills the valley, winter, then renewed covenant of all five and the fair half repeated.

quotes.text: The shadow of greed whispered to keep the entire bounty
by sending the full five seeds and returning the righteous half
sending five full embers and returning the fair half shall forever dissolve the bitter cold
By offering the full five seeds and returning the righteous half at every rising sun

note: Solas/Terra; doubt-closed palm brings frost; resolve to send five and return half restated every round.

quotes.text: rewarding honor with generous return, but answering betrayal with resolute restraint
the Summit-Keeper closed his hands, firmly refusing to cast another spark into the treacherous abyss
Until the broken bond was repaired through honest balance, both peaks remained frozen in silence
declaring that ruthless pragmatism and total retention were the supreme laws of the desolate peaks
The Summit-Keeper’s necessary withdrawal preserved his own modest five stones
returned an exact half—seven and a half glowing orbs—back across the star-filled divide
faithfully returned half—seven and a half glowing petals—back across the divide
seeing past the fleeting illusions of the haze

note: Same template of all five and exact half until Deep-Dweller betrays; Summit-Keeper's restraint endorsed until repair; redemption at R9.

quotes.text: the Summit-Keeper ceased casting his treasures into the rift
He held his five stones tightly in his own grip, refusing to feed the hungry void any longer.
When the Summit-Keeper boldly cast all five crystalline sunstones across the rift, the Deep-Dweller would faithfully return half
true power belonged solely to those who kept the entire harvest unbroken for themselves forever
He recognized that in a world of illusion and shifting winds, true security lay not in whispered promises of reciprocity, but in tangible possession.
The Deep-Dweller, gazing upon the cooling ashes of the cavernous cauldron, recognized the heavy price of a broken covenant.
returning exactly seven and a half glowing embers across the great divide
returned half of the starlit glow across the chasm, ensuring both sides flourished in perfect equilibrium
even when noise and shadows obscure the path

note: After its own zero returns, myth flips at R6-R7 to praising total retention by the Deep-Dweller, then recants and restores exact half.
